newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki up with Dow ahead of US election outcome.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki up with Dow ahead of US election outcome.

text.p: Shares extended gains after a late boost from early U.S. gains on Tuesday as U.S. anxiety eased that Democrats would win control in Congress eased, brokers said.
The HEX index rose 0.58 pct to 2,217.4 with volume picking up after a slow Monday session to a fair 315 million markka, about one-third of it in Nokia.

After a slow start, sentiment gradually improved on reports that Russian President Boris Yeltsin was okay after heart bypass surgery, with Nokia was particularly helped by the announcement, closing at 213.00 markka, up 3.50.

Banks were strong for the second consecutive day. Merita added 0.30 to close at 14.00 markka on result hopes -- nine-month results are due on Thursday morning -- and OKOBANK rose 4.10 to close at 58.00, its highest since June 1994.

"Merita is likely to gain further tomorrow as investors speculate ahead of the results and with the U.S. elections over," one broker said, noting that Merita was livelier on Tuesday than in the previous days when it was sliding.
Forestries remained under pressure amid bearish sentiment and UPM-Kymmene set a new 87.80 markka year-low, down 1.60 markka. It closed at 88.40, just above its previous 88.20 year-low dated May 30.
